component.name: AgentBridge
component.summary: Self-hosted AI personal assistant that automates office work

description.p: AgentBridge is a self-hosted server that runs its own AI agents behind two primary interfaces in a single process: a full-screen chat terminal (TUI) and an HTTP API that speaks the standard OpenAI protocol, so any OpenAI-compatible client drives the same agents.

This desktop package starts the engine locally and opens the bundled Giraffe AI web client in its own window — a real desktop application that looks and behaves like any other app on your Linux desktop, with an application icon in the launcher.

Bring agentic power to your office work without sacrificing privacy: connect to your preferred AI (a local model such as Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible provider) and the agent drafts documents, works on spreadsheets and presentations, interacts with email and Telegram, browses the web and reads your local knowledge base — your files never leave your machine.
